title: Bir günüm: sabahtan akşama
summary: Gününü sabahtan akşama anlatma: uyanmak, işe gitmek, eve gelmek, İngilizce çalışmak. Saat söyleme (at six o'clock, at half past eight) ve haftanın günleri.

warmup.tr: İş sağlığı ve güvenliği uzmanıyım. (health'i atlama)

warmup.tr: Evet, zor, çünkü bazı insanlar zor. (people → are; sebebi because ile bağla)

words.intro: Okunuşlar Türkçe harflerle yazıldı. Bu derste 27 yeni kelime var; Ders 2'den dört kelime tekrar için en altta.

notes.title: Saat söyleme
notes.text: at six **o'clock** = saat altıda · at **half past** six = altı buçukta · at seven = yedide (o'clock söylemesen de olur). Saatten önce hep **at**.

notes.title: Günün bölümleri
notes.text: **in** the morning (sabah) · **in** the afternoon (öğleden sonra) · **in** the evening (akşam) · ama **at** night (gece).

notes.title: Günler
notes.text: Günler hep büyük harfle yazılır: **Monday**, **Sunday**. Günden önce **on**: **on** Sunday = pazar günü. **from** Monday **to** Saturday = pazartesiden cumartesiye.

notes.title: Ali'yi anlatırken: -s, -es, has, goes
notes.text: I wake up → he wake**s** up · I finish → he finish**es** · I study → he stud**ies** · düzensiz: I **have** → he **has**, I **go** → he **goes**.

notes.title: then = sonra
notes.text: Günü sırayla anlatırken cümleleri **then** ile bağla: I study English at half past eight. **Then** I go to bed at ten.

tables.title: Haftanın günleri
tables.intro: Sen pazartesiden cumartesiye çalışıyorsun; pazar izin günün.

items.en: I wake up at six o'clock.
I have breakfast at half past six.
I leave home at seven.
I drive to the construction site.
I start work at eight.
I check the site every day.
I have lunch at twelve o'clock.
items.tr: Saat on ikide öğle yemeği yiyorum.

items.en: I finish work at six.
I come home at seven.
I have dinner with my family.
I study English at half past eight.
I go to bed at ten.
I work from Monday to Saturday.
Sunday is my day off.
On Sunday I am with my family.
I am tired in the evening.
What time do you wake up?
What time do you go to bed?
When is your day off?
What do you do on Sunday?

patterns.footnote: Saatler örnek; kendi gününe göre değiştirerek söyle. Dikkat: "What do you do?" tek başına "Ne iş yapıyorsun?" demek; "What do you do on Sunday?" ise "Pazar günü ne yapıyorsun?".

lines.en: What time do you wake up?
I wake up at six o'clock.
Do you have breakfast?
Yes, I have breakfast at half past six.
What time do you leave home?
I leave home at seven. I drive to the construction site.
lines.tr: Yedide evden çıkıyorum. Arabayla şantiyeye gidiyorum.

lines.en: What time do you start work?
I start at eight and finish at six.
What do you do in the evening?
I come home at seven. I have dinner with my family.
lines.tr: Yedide eve geliyorum. Ailemle akşam yemeği yiyorum.

lines.en: When do you study English?
I study English at half past eight. Then I go to bed at ten.
lines.tr: Sekiz buçukta İngilizce çalışıyorum. Sonra onda yatıyorum.

lines.en: How many days a week do you work?
I work six days a week, from Monday to Saturday.
lines.tr: Haftada altı gün, pazartesiden cumartesiye çalışıyorum.

lines.en: When is your day off?
Sunday is my day off.
What do you do on Sunday?
I am with my family. I study English too.
Are you tired on Saturday evening?
Yes, I am. But on Sunday I am happy, because I am with my family.
lines.tr: Evet. Ama pazar günü mutluyum, çünkü ailemleyim.

reading.title: Ali's day

sentences.en: Ali wakes up at six o'clock.
He has breakfast at half past six.
He leaves home at seven and drives to the construction site.
sentences.tr: Yedide evden çıkıyor ve arabayla şantiyeye gidiyor.

sentences.en: He checks the site every day.
He has lunch at twelve o'clock.
sentences.tr: Saat on ikide öğle yemeği yiyor.

sentences.en: He finishes work at six and comes home at seven.
sentences.tr: Altıda işi bitiriyor, yedide eve geliyor.

sentences.en: He has dinner with his family.
At half past eight he studies English.
He goes to bed at ten. Sunday is his day off.
sentences.tr: Onda yatıyor. Pazar onun izin günü.

reading.note: Ali'den bahsederken fiile **-s** gelir: he **wakes**, he **leaves**, he **checks**. -sh ile bitince **-es**: he **finishes**. y → ies: he **studies**. Düzensizler: have → **has**, go → **goes**. Kendinden bahsederken ek yok: I **wake** up, I **have** breakfast, I **go** to bed.

rewrite.prompt: Metni kendi ağzından, kendi saatlerinle yeniden yaz: Ali wakes up → I wake up, he has → I have, he goes → I go, his → my.
rewrite.model: I wake up at six o'clock. I have breakfast at half past six. I leave home at seven and drive to the construction site. I start work at eight. I check the site every day. I have lunch at twelve o'clock. I finish work at six and come home at seven. I have dinner with my family. At half past eight I study English. I go to bed at ten. Sunday is my day off.
